query: SELECT m.conversation_id, m.name, m.state, lc.lifecycle AS "lifecycle?", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM lc.created_at)::bigint AS "lifecycle_at?", lc.frame->'event'->>'reason' AS "failed_reason?", (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(e.created_at))::bigint FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND e.seq >= lc.seq) AS "progress_at?", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages r WHERE r.channel_id = $2 AND r.type = 'report' AND r.author_id = m.conversation_id::text AND r.seq > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(a.seq) FROM channel_messages a WHERE a.channel_id = $2 AND a.type = 'assign' AND a.to_conversation = m.conversation_id), 0)) AS "reported!", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages w WHERE w.channel_id = $2 AND w.seq > m.last_read_seq AND (w.to_conversation = m.conversation_id OR w.to_kind IN ('members', 'team'))) AS "waiting!", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages n WHERE n.channel_id = $2 AND n.type = 'notice' AND n.body->>'kind' = 'member_idle' AND n.body->>'member' = m.name AND n.created_at >= lc.created_at) AS "idle_notified!", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages n WHERE n.channel_id = $2 AND n.type = 'notice' AND n.body->>'kind' = 'member_stuck' AND n.body->>'member' = m.name AND n.created_at >= (SELECT MAX(e.created_at) FROM events e WHERE e.conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND e.seq >= lc.seq)) AS "stuck_notified!", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages n WHERE n.channel_id = $2 AND n.type = 'notice' AND n.body->>'kind' = 'member_failed' AND n.body->>'member' = m.name AND n.created_at >= lc.created_at) AS "failed_notified!" FROM agent_team_members m LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT seq, lifecycle, created_at, frame FROM events WHERE conversation_id = m.conversation_id AND lifecycle IS NOT NULL ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 1) lc ON true WHERE m.team_id = $1 ORDER BY m.created_at
